# Tate

> > Tate's digital presence showcasing Britain's national collection of British art and international modern and contemporary art across Tate Britain, Tate Modern, and partner institutions.

Tate encompasses research projects, conservation initiatives, educational programs, and digital innovations including special imaging techniques like Polynomial Texture Mapping, diversity and inclusion research, and youth engagement programs. The organization advances both art scholarship and public access through technology-enabled conservation, collaborative projects, and educational outreach.

## Key Topics

- Tate Britain
- Tate Modern
- Collection acquisitions
- Art conservation
- Polynomial Texture Mapping (PTM)
- Painting conservation
- Art education and schools outreach
- Diversity and inclusion
- Frank Auerbach
- Modern paints research
- Digital imaging techniques
- Youth engagement programs
- Contemporary art research
- Museum technology and IoT
- Curatorial practice

## Collection & Acquisitions

- [Acquisitions](https://www.tate.org.uk/about-us/collection/acquisitions): Collection acquisition strategy and process overview

## Conservation & Technical Research

- [Variable light: Frank Auerbach's Rimbaud (1976) and Head of E.O.W. (1957–8)](https://www.tate.org.uk/about-us/projects/variable-light-frank-auerbachs-rimbaud-1976-and-head-eow-1957-8): Interactive imaging tool reveals texture in Auerbach's paintings
- [Contemporary Art Research](https://www.tate.org.uk/about-us/projects/contemporary-art-research): Research on modern paints and conservation completed 2009
- [Tate AXA Art Modern Paints Project (TAAMPP)](https://www.tate.org.uk/about-us/projects/tate-axa-art-modern-paints-project-taampp): Research on cleaning acrylic paintings conservation techniques
- [The conservation of John Foley's sculpture of Sir Joshua Reynolds P.R.A](https://www.tate.org.uk/about-us/projects/conservation-john-foleys-sculpture-sir-joshua-reynolds-pra): Conservation of Foley's marble Reynolds sculpture for 2005 display

## Digital Innovation & Technology

- [Culture Mining](https://www.tate.org.uk/about-us/projects/culture-mining): Collaborative research on audiovisual content categorization and search
- [Logistics 4.0: Securing High Value Goods using Self-protecting Edge Compute](https://www.tate.org.uk/about-us/projects/logistics-40): IoT-based artwork tracking and security research project
- [Tate Worlds: Art Reimagined for Minecraft](https://www.tate.org.uk/about-us/projects/tate-worlds-art-reimagined-minecraft): Minecraft maps inspired by Tate collection artworks

## Education & Youth Programs

- [Circuit](https://www.tate.org.uk/about-us/projects/circuit-programme): National youth engagement programme for gallery access
- [Verbal Eyes](https://www.tate.org.uk/about-us/projects/verbal-eyes): Tate Britain schools outreach project for primary education
- [Resources](https://www.tate.org.uk/about-us/projects/unilever-series-turbinegeneration/resources): Educational resources for Unilever Series turbinegeneration project
- [Looking for Change: Case Study](https://www.tate.org.uk/about-us/projects/looking-change/looking-change-case-study): Teacher perspective from Charles Dickens Primary School project

## Diversity, Inclusion & Curatorial Practice

- [Inclusive Futures](https://www.tate.org.uk/about-us/projects/inclusive-futures): Research initiative on diversity and race equality in cultural sector
- [Curating in Africa symposium](https://www.tate.org.uk/about-us/projects/curating-africa-symposium): Symposium on contemporary curatorial practice in Africa
- [Professional Skills for the Museum and Heritage Sector](https://www.tate.org.uk/about-us/projects/nacca/professional-skills-museum-and-heritage-sector): NACCA Winter School 2017 doctoral training event at Tate
- [Where is Art Criticism? : Art Writers in Britain](https://www.tate.org.uk/about-us/projects/art-writers-britain/where-is-art-criticism): Workshop summary on state of art criticism from May 2013

## Building & Infrastructure Projects

- [The case for change](https://www.tate.org.uk/about-us/projects/millbank-project/case-change): Millbank Project rationale for Tate Britain renovation and expansion

## Optional

- [Archives & Access project: Artist Rabab Ghazoul and Welsh choirs bring new voices to Josef Herman's archive](https://www.tate.org.uk/about-us/projects/transforming-tate-britain-archives-access/archives-access-project-artist-rabab): Artist Rabab Ghazoul discusses Josef Herman archive outreach project
- [Today](https://www.tate.org.uk/about-us/projects/tate-modern-project/today): Live updates from Tate Modern Project construction site
